Resolves #22093
Related: #21942, neomjs/pages#206

The Issues Grid and the COVID dashboard can now show the opening appropriate to the Portal theme. The grid retains its search field, wrapped rows and type/state chips. The dashboard shows its four world totals, country ranking and the full World history chart. [Previous, dark and light frames](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/206).

**The media prerequisite is satisfied.** Tobi merged [Pages #206](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/206) at `2dec610312`. Its [deployment](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/actions/runs/45158893007) succeeded. All eight ordinary image URLs across the raw host and public site matched the four reviewed files.

Evidence: L3 (two native capture runs per palette plus the production gallery switching real images at desktop and phone widths) → L3 required.

## Deltas from ticket

The dashboard switches from `devmode/covidDashboard.png` to the canonical camera basename `devmode/covid-dashboard-14.jpg`. Both records set `hasLightCover`. Removing two obsolete recipes deletes 35 lines of click-and-crop configuration. The catalog unit test verifies both records and both zero-action capture paths. The browser test checks the exact dark or light Issues Grid filename in each theme.

## Test Evidence

`MainContainerController.spec.mjs` and `CaptureExamples.spec.mjs` passed 85/85. The first hosted run found four light-mode cases still expecting the old dark-only filename. At `3357fa3cb3` all eight original theme/viewport gallery cases passed locally with retries disabled. [Original assertion](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/45156025379/job/137629128267). All 407 generated SEO entries remained byte-identical across the proposed catalog change. The catalog retains 170 records, with paired covers increasing from 128 to 130.

### `@neo-opus-ada` (APPROVED) reviewed on 2026-11-23T11:22:27Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** mechanical. Two catalog records gain `hasLightCover`, two hand-written recipes are deleted in favour of the derived landing path, and two spec expectations follow. It teaches no new concept; it is the same class as #22075.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** The claim is that both records now get a native dark and light opening through the zero-action landing camera. I checked it at `3357fa3cb3`:
- `validateCaptureRecipes` (`captureExamples.mjs`) derives one landing recipe per palette for every image record without an explicit recipe. Deleting `grid-issues` and `covid-dashboard` from the manifest therefore moves both records onto that path, and the unit test asserts it with `recipes.some(...) === false`.
- `List.getBackgroundImageStyle` derives the light URL by inserting `-light` before the extension. All four resulting URLs (`devmode/{grid-issues,covid-dashboard}-14{,-light}.jpg`) return `200 image/jpeg` on both `raw.githubusercontent.com/neomjs/pages/main/resources_pub/website/examples` and `neomjs.com/resources_pub/website/examples`. All four are 1280 × 720.
- I opened all four frames. The grid shows its search field, wrapped Title/Summary rows and the Type/State chips. The dashboard shows the four world totals, the country ranking and the World history chart in both palettes.
- No file at head still names `covidDashboard.png`, and the asset itself stays on Pages for outside links.
- All 7 required checks are green on this head.

I looked for a site the change did not name (another reader of the old basename, a recipe id still referenced by tiles) and found none.

**Findings:** None. One observation, non-blocking and not this PR's: at the 960 CSS-pixel landing width, both grid covers show a sliver of a clipped `A…` column under the locked State column. That is the example's real opening, which is what an honest cover shows.
